h1: Custom Poly Propylene School Spirit Items
metaTitle: Custom Poly Propylene School Spirit | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom poly propylene school spirit items for rallies and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Poly propylene offers a lightweight, durable fabric that holds vibrant colors well, making it ideal for school spirit items like rally towels, pennants, and drawstring bags. Unlike cotton, these items resist moisture and wrinkles, standing up to outdoor games and repeated use. Choose poly propylene for cost-effective custom orders that keep your school colors bright through every season.
